display_long_description:
You lost your ship, your crew and your life. You are offered a contract to fight and rob the Evil Trade Empire for a chance at redemption. 

Now you must prove yourself worthy in Pirate Purgatory. Skeleton Crew is a solo or two-player co-op game of pirate heists. 

Complete daring missions with your own crew of skeletons — and a friend, if you want to bring one. Fill your hoard with the Trophies you recover.

**Full-Body Physicality & Improvised Combat** Your pirate is a physical body in the world — climb, swing, and feel the recoil of every shot. Out of bullets? Smash your enemies with the butt of your pistol – until it breaks.
[media]

**Two-Player Online Co-Op** Go in solo or drag your best friend into the afterlife with you. Two players by invite only.
[media]

**A Crew of Your Own** Your gun crew is a pack of skeletons. Put them on the cannons, line up the shot yourself, and give the word.
[media]

**A Target, No Fixed Route** Some missions want treasure. Some want a ship caught at sea. How you get there is your problem.
[media]

**Ready to fill your Hoard?**

**Early Access — What You're Signing Up For**

Launching with the tutorial, the home base Hoard, 3 full missions and a bonus level — with full online two player co-op from day one. More missions, weapons, and chaos are on the way.

Invite only, no public lobbies. Just you, a bunch of brainless skeletons and maybe your friend.

Hit a bug or something feels off? Come tell us on Discord [https://discord.gg/u9p8CsHRec] — we're a small crew but we read every report
